editorial:
Imagine a guy who makes a living just being a jerk to people over the radio. That is Brent Ziff, and he is basically the king of the internet shock-jock world. You get to watch him roast callers and act like he is untouchable while his fans love every second of it. The vibe starts out like a typical day at the office, but it quickly turns into something much weirder. Everything changes when a mysterious caller rings in with a message that Brent cannot just ignore or laugh off, turning his arrogant world upside down in a heartbeat.

What really works here is the tension. The acting feels real, and the way the story builds up keeps you guessing about what is actually happening. While the plot slows down a bit in the middle, the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy a mix of sci-fi and dark humor, you will love this one.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the caller is actually Brent from the future. He calls back in time to warn his younger self about a terrible mistake that ruins his life. In the final scenes, Brent has to decide if he will change his personality and how he treats people to avoid a dark future. He eventually realizes that being mean to everyone isn't worth it, and the movie ends with him choosing a better path.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves time travel mysteries and sarcastic characters.
